title: Mozambique — Coast, Islands & Spice
sub: Five days of Indian Ocean, dhow sails and peri-peri — tap a day to sail it: the beaches, the reefs, the food, where you sleep.
cap: Illustrative 5-day coastal route · real Mozambican towns shown for bearing; lodges & food generic (SO-1b). A demo a real tour operator could publish as their own — free to claim and replace with their product. AI imagery.

days.title: Capital of tiles & prawns
days.summary: A day in a capital of Portuguese facades, iron markets and the best prawns on the continent.

stops.name: Maputo · arrival
stops.blurb: Wide jacaranda avenues, Mediterranean balconies and Indian Ocean humidity in equal measure.

stops.name: The iron market
stops.blurb: A cast-iron market hall shipped out in pieces a century ago, still stacked with chillies, cashews and fish.

stops.name: Peri-peri prawns
stops.blurb: Giant prawns split, drowned in garlic, lemon and fierce bird's-eye chilli, grilled hot — with cold beer and rough bread.

stops.name: The bay at dusk
stops.blurb: Rooftop view over the harbour, cranes going quiet, the whole sky turning peach.

stops.name: Colonial townhouse rooms
stops.blurb: High ceilings, shutters, a slow fan and mosaic floors that stay cool all day.

days.title: North to the whale-shark coast
days.summary: Up the coast road to a bay where the world's biggest fish cruises past all year.

stops.name: Out of the capital
stops.blurb: Coconut palms, roadside pineapple stalls and speed bumps in every village.

stops.name: Cassava leaf & coconut stew
stops.blurb: Pounded cassava leaves slow-cooked with coconut milk, peanuts and prawns, served over rice — the country's signature dish.

stops.name: Dhow across the bay
stops.blurb: A lateen-sailed dhow ferrying passengers and bicycles across a turquoise bay, unchanged in centuries.

stops.name: Whale sharks offshore
stops.blurb: A shape the size of a bus rising slowly under the boat, spotted like a night sky.

stops.name: Beach cabana in the dunes
stops.blurb: Reed and thatch on a vegetated dune, ten steps down to a wide empty beach.

days.title: Reef, market & sand road
days.summary: A morning on the reef, then north again on sand roads to the archipelago gateway.

stops.name: Morning on the reef
stops.blurb: Warm water, soft corals, and manta rays queuing at a cleaning station like traffic.

stops.name: Roadside cashew stand
stops.blurb: Cashews roasted in the shell over a drum fire, sold hot in newspaper cones by the kilo.

stops.name: Bread, chilli & grilled fish
stops.blurb: Crusty rolls baked in a wood oven, split and filled with grilled fish and a spoon of chilli oil.

stops.name: First sight of the islands
stops.blurb: Five sand islands strung along the horizon, water going from jade to deep blue.

stops.name: Fishing-town guesthouse
stops.blurb: Whitewashed rooms above a working beach where the boats are dragged up at dusk.

days.title: The archipelago
days.summary: Out to the sand islands — dunes in the sea, sandbanks that appear and vanish with the tide.

stops.name: Dhow to the islands
stops.blurb: Sailing out on the morning wind with the boom swinging low over your head.

stops.name: Sandbank at low tide
stops.blurb: A crescent of white sand that exists for four hours a day, surrounded by every shade of blue there is.

stops.name: Two-mile reef
stops.blurb: Bright shallow reef thick with clownfish, parrotfish and the occasional passing turtle.

stops.name: Lobster on the beach
stops.blurb: Split lobster grilled over coconut husks with lemon and chilli butter, feet in the sand.

stops.name: Island dune lodge
stops.blurb: Thatched chalets high on a vegetated dune with nothing but ocean in three directions.

days.title: North to the stone island
days.summary: A flight north to a tiny coral island that was the capital for four centuries.

stops.name: North along the coast
stops.blurb: The coastline from above: reef, mangrove, river mouth, repeat, for eight hundred kilometres.

stops.name: The old stone town
stops.blurb: Coral-stone streets, a Portuguese sea fort, and a chapel claimed to be the oldest European building south of the Sahara.

stops.name: The long causeway
stops.blurb: A three-kilometre single-lane bridge to the mainland, best walked at sunset.

stops.name: Spiced coconut curry
stops.blurb: Fish curry heavy with coconut, cinnamon and clove — Arab, Indian and Portuguese cooking in one pot.

stops.name: Journey's end · the island
stops.blurb: Sundowners on a fort wall built in 1558, dhows coming home below.
